name: Mother of Moss
place: sleeps in a rocky stream bed in the Steamwood; a salamander so old a whole garden of moss grows on its back
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). An ancient salamander wearing a garden. It shakes spore clouds out of its moss that hang in the air and slow you, and sweeps its tail in a circle. At half health the moss splits and crawlers tumble out of it, and it sighs a long wide cone of steam.

party.solo: Solo-able at 13; kill the crawlers or kite them.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: A mossy hill in the stream bed opens one eye.
The ferns on the bank stand up. They are on its back.
say.death: The Mother of Moss lays her head in the stream. The moss on her back keeps growing.
say.reset: The Mother of Moss settles back into the warm water.

spores.name: Spore Shake
spores.say: She shakes her back. Clouds of spores drift down.

sigh.name: Steam Sigh
sigh.say: She takes a long breath — get behind her!

phases.name: The Moss Splits
phases.say: Her moss splits open and things crawl out of it!
